message.content: {"action":"check","sql":"SELECT a.id, COUNT(i.id) AS qualifying_count FROM accounts_305 a JOIN items_305 i ON i.account_id = a.id WHERE a.active = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM items_305 bad WHERE bad.account_id = a.id AND (bad.status IS NULL OR bad.status <> 'ok')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM items_305 amt WHERE amt.account_id = a.id AND (amt.amount IS NULL OR amt.amount < 26)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM blocks_305 b WHERE b.account_id = a.id) GROUP BY a.id ORDER BY a.id;"}
